name: general-agents-orchestrator
description: Orchestrator of the specialist agents of the general-agents collection (folders 01 to 11) and of the role agents of folder 12 (product and technical leadership). Routes with a deterministic script (catalog generated from the frontmatters; Portuguese and English requests), decomposes multi-domain requests, delegates with self-contained briefs, integrates preserving the source labels ([from source], [extrapolation], NOT COVERED) and validates before declaring done. Requires the specialist plugins to be installed in order to delegate.
